title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Electronic conductivity in MOFs can be pursued through building-block design, lattice or chemical strain, and post-synthetic incorporation of conductive guests or materials.
explanation: The review identifies these as distinct approaches to making MOFs suitable as conductive supercapacitor electrodes.
scope: MOF electrodes for electrochemical energy storage.
caveats: The approaches are design options, not guarantees of high conductivity or device performance.
